messages:
anika: quick thread - pricing playbook question: should embeddings be a separate tier or folded into existing text-gen tiers? want a recommendation for tomorrow's GTM call.
rachel: embeddings workload is different (high qps, low token length). customers hate surprise per-embedding spikes. separate tier seems cleaner.
sam: operationally separate tiers mean separate quotas and billing units. easier to instrument but adds complexity to pricing page.
dmitri: suggestion: keep unified account-level commit but surface allocation buckets: `gen_units` and `embed_units`. conversion rule: 1 gen_unit = 2 embed_units for pricing math.anika: typo (meant anika)
anika: good idea. also add an opt-in "embed add-on" for customers who only use embeddings. pricing example: base commit $X covers gen_units, embed add-on priced at $Y per 1M embeds.
rachel: sales + cs: add migration plan for customers using burst-credits now. propose pro-rate and map historical usage to recommended split.
sam: console UX: show combined commit pie and split usage bars; warning when one bucket drains.
dmitri: launch criteria: 1) billing unit & conversion rule, 2) UI allocation + alerts, 3) docs + migration guide, 4) finance sign-off on unit price.anika: (typo)
anika: pilot ask: 5 customers (2 embed-first, 3 gen-heavy) for 60d. ben to pick. I'll draft the pricing example and add to the GTM deck. @pricing-bot create epic. :rocket:
pricing-bot: Created epic PRIC-EMBEDGEN (https://go/repo/PRIC-EMBEDGEN) - owners: anika, rachel, dmitri.
